author: Mehrp
body:
I was recently warned for using caps, but I not only feel that it should be appealed but that it was also handled unprofessionally.  Before I started using caps, I was crafting some diamond armour until it was broken by AwesomeAdar. I luckily managed to record it (https://gyazo.com/1bb98e0b0c0a24d6ab21bda178e64886), although I was unawares of this at the time. I sent a report in and then made another crafting table but didn't craft anything as I knew he would break it. I also did this in the hopes that the moderator who attended the report would see it and be able to punish him. (https://gyazo.com/c27e500923f8bd5ae1d8e54f17c73543) However, when a moderator didn't attend I got quite enraged and used caps to try and make him stop, as most normal players would do. This actually worked, he ran off and I think he went to try and break other people's crafting tables, not mine. However, a moderator punished me for using caps. When I delved further, the moderator hadn't actually attended the report, so he didn't know the context behind my caps. However, after lots of conversation I realised he had left it for another moderator. however, no moderator came. I was still quite miffed at the whole incident and wanted to know who was responsible for not attending my report, however, the response I got was https://gyazo.com/2bcab4853468900f9c0c8b5b14155f99. "We can miss a few reports" Why is it moderators can idle around and miss reports? I get that they need to be able to play, but when other moderators are AFK and not attending reports, they should have the decency to attend. Rule 9 section A also states that if anyone is breaking a rule in response to another person's actions, the person will be held partly accountable. Therefore, I would also like to say that  it is in part, not my fault and instead AwesomeAdar's. He should, therefore, be punished. In addition, because I was provoked and because the caps were in a response to him, I feel like I should have been verballed. because I now know that verbals warns and warns which are recorded on your infractions are interchangeable, I feel that my warn should be appealed as I should have gotten a verbal, if you like I will happily take a verbal imminently . I accept that moderators can make misjudgements, and I feel like this was one of them. but because it was a mistake, I would very much insist on getting this punishment appealed. A warn it may be, but an infraction it is nonetheless.

 I hope you recognise my concern for how this was handled, 
-Awesomerp

title: Appeal for what an unjust warn

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Hello,

After looking at the logs, timings and explanations I will ban Adar, however you shouldn't have raged and used caps, you could've filed an online report and it would all be a lot easier for everyone so your warn will remain valid.
-Denied

Regards,
Auratix_,
Senior Moderator
